summary: Part 4 of the 1.1 Onboarding App (Seller) video (13:49 to 14:39). The trainer moves a seller from the Seller Onboarding App into the Fulfillment App. The accepted profile's 'Have you watched the Fulfillment App video ?' field is changed from 'Not yet' to Yes and saved, and the form then shows a Link to Fulfillment App. Opening that link shows the Fulfillment App SKU list. The Drive video page is still loading on screen and its content is not shown. The trainer then recaps the four onboarding stages on the slide deck and ends on slide 1. 11 frames opened. Key unclear point: the Drive video is titled '0. Revibe Ecosystem' while the form asks about the 'Fulfillment App video'.

facts.statement: Full onboarding: after a significant volume of orders the seller is fully onboarded. This means direct shipping to customers is allowed, and there are no more limits.

evidence.quote: Once you have reached significant volume of orders you will be fully onboarded; It means direct shipping to customers will be allowed; No more limits !
